title: Rich Chickpea & Haloumi Korma Curry
subtitle: with Roasted Veggies & Butter Rice
description: This chickpea, haloumi and veggie packed dinner delight will have you salivating for more! Soak up all richness and depth of our bold curry flavours with a bed of fluffy butter rice.

steps.text:
• Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced. Drain and rinse chickpeas.
• Cut carrot and zucchini into bite-sized chunks. Cut tomato into wedges. Place carrot, zucchini and tomato on the lined oven tray. Season with salt and drizzle with olive oil.
• Toss to coat and roast until tender, 20-25 mins.
• To a medium bowl, add haloumi and cover with water to soak.

• Meanwhile, melt the butter with a dash of olive oil over medium heat in a medium saucepan.
• Add basmati rice, the water (for the rice) and a generous pinch of salt and bring to the boil.
• Reduce heat to low and cover with a lid. Cook for 10 mins, then remove from heat and keep covered until rice is tender and the water is absorbed, 10 mins.

• Drain haloumi and pat dry. Cut the haloumi into bite-sized chunks.
• When veggies have 10 mins remaining, in a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.
• Cook haloumi until browned, 3-4 mins. Transfer to a plate.
• Wipe out frying pan and return to medium-high heat with a drizzle of olive oil. Cook chickpeas until softened, 2-3 mins.
• Add mild curry paste and cook until fragrant, 1 min.
• Add cooking cream, the water (for the curry) and a pinch of brown sugar. Reduce heat to low and simmer until slightly thickened, 2-3 mins.
• Remove from heat and stir through roast veggies and cooked haloumi. Season to taste.
Divide butter rice and haloumi, chickpea korma curry between bowls.
